title: uuencoding-multi/yencoding-multi: error types missing Clone derive
description:
Why this exists: uuencoding_multi/src/error.rs defines MultiUuError with #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] but not Clone. yencoding_multi/src/error.rs defines AssemblyError with #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] but not Clone.

What goes wrong: Result<T, MultiUuError> and Result<T, AssemblyError> cannot be cloned. This prevents storing errors in collections or propagating them through code that expects Clone (e.g. channel sends, cache entries). The inconsistency with uuencoding::UuError (which does derive Clone) makes the API surface non-uniform. The Rust standard practice is to derive Clone on error types unless they contain non-Clone fields — MultiUuError::DecodeError(uuencoding::UuError) is clonable if UuError is clonable, and AssemblyError has no non-Clone fields.

Fix: add Clone to MultiUuError and AssemblyError, contingent on UuError (MIME-8zt.37 / yencoding) also gaining Clone.
